summary: All acceptance criteria satisfied. @vue-flow/core@^1.48.2 and @dagrejs/dagre@^3.0.0 are correctly placed in the dependencies section of package.json and locked in pnpm-lock.yaml. The CSS import @vue-flow/core/dist/style.css is appended to the css[] array in nuxt.config.ts alongside the existing Tailwind entry — SSR is not globally disabled, no *.client.vue created, and no unnecessary vite.optimizeDeps added (YAGNI correctly applied). frontend/types/funnel.ts adds CanvasPosition, FunnelNote, and all six additive nullable fields (FunnelStep.canvasPosition, FunnelTrigger.canvasPosition, FunnelResponse.notes, UpdateFunnelRequest.notes) with the correct optional+nullable shape (?: T | null), matching the backend DTO contract byte-for-byte. Doc comments follow the established file style. No existing interface contract is broken. Zero findings.
